bug_mechanics: parseJoinCode splits host:port on hostPort.lastIndexOf(":"). For a port-less bracketed IPv6 host like [::1], the last colon is INSIDE the brackets, so the split treats "]" as the port region: host becomes "[:" and the URL concatenates to "wss://[::1/ws". The PR's fix adds `!hostPort.endsWith("]")` to the hasPort condition so bracketed literals ending in "]" never split.
